queries.sql: SELECT "date", "store_id", CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM("revenue"), 0) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE divideDecimal(SUM("gross_margin"), COALESCE(nullIf(SUM("revenue"), 0), 1), 6) END AS "gross_margin_pct" FROM "dm"."sales_daily" GROUP BY "date", "store_id"
